_README: Hand-written per-capability facts, merged OVER the extracted record by
vllm-capability-extract.py.  Keyed by the capability `key` (which is
`<id>@<lane>:<module>` when the id is ambiguous across lanes) or by bare `id`
when it is unique.  Nothing here is regenerated - the extraction is.
Use it for: one-line descriptions the docstring does not give, upstream
absorption evidence, retirement rationale, and - most valuable - a
verification handle for anything the AST cannot see.
Fields the verifier understands beyond the extracted ones:
markers  []  extra marker strings to look for (merged, not replaced)
targets  []  extra container-absolute target paths
status   ''  overrides the heuristic status
note     ''  free text, shown in --json output
superseded_by ''  a checked absorption verdict that NAMES the absorbing
commit or PR and quotes the absorbing code -> N/A
noop_by_precondition ''  the patch ran, checked a precondition and found
its bug unreachable on this deployment -> N/A.  NOT
retirable: it re-engages when the precondition breaks.
behavioural_delta ''  free text.  Use it whenever 'absorbed' is not
'identical' - upstream's version may route or cover
differently (P27 routing, PN88 TQ coverage gap).
effective_env_flag ''  the gate the MODULE itself checks, when it differs
from the registry's env_flag -> DARK when unset/off
_BLIND_SPOTS: These five capabilities have NO verification signal of any kind - not a
marker, not an attribute, not a metric.  If the ledger's promise is 'an
upstream bump cannot silently drop work', these are precisely where it
would happen, and two of them are LIVE in production right now.
Fixing them means adding a marker string to the patch, which is a change to
a patch module and therefore out of scope for the session that built this.
P5b     lane-2 memory/p5b_page_size_pad_smaller  - env coordinator for P5
PN289   lane-2 observability/genesis_process_info - ON in both composes
PN201   lane-2 streaming/pn201_scheduler_empty_cache - ON in both composes

PN364.note: Two findings, and the second is bigger than the row. (1) The row was scored on GENESIS_PN364_MARKER = '_genesis_pn364_hybrid_gdn_warmup_installed', which is the ATTRIBUTE NAME in 'setattr(wrapped, GENESIS_PN364_MARKER, True)'. It is a name on a function object and can never appear in a file, so the row read 'marker absent anywhere in installed vllm' forever. Fixed at source in the extractor. (2) The capability is GENUINELY INERT: it wraps Worker.compile_or_warm_up_model by assignment in the apply_all process, and `exec vllm serve` replaces that process. So does the whole JIT-warmup family - PN126, PN128, PN129 and PN130 are the same shape, all announce 'RESULT applied' every boot, and all reach nothing. PN364 was the only one the ledger flagged, and it flagged it for the wrong reason. COST TO RESTORE: convert all five to text patches writing a self-install hook into v1/worker/gpu_worker.py (the P103/P39a pattern, now packaged as sndr/engines/vllm/patches/spec_decode/probes/self_install.py), re-anchor compile_or_warm_up_model on the cherrymax pin, and accept a boot with the '[PN364] Pass N done' lines visible in the SERVER log as the acceptance test. Payoff is TTFT-only (first request after a restart), no steady-state TPS. PN364 chains after the other four, so a partial restore gets the smallest share.

PN88.superseded_by: vllm#47574, MERGED upstream as 8ce53a616 '[Bugfix] Zero new KV blocks for quantized + sliding-window hybrid caches' (EdalatiAli, 2026-07-20), a strict ancestor of the boot pin's build base 4e2e9bf00. Absorbing code, kv_cache_interface.py:996-1023 in the PRISTINE boot pin: a `has_mixed_precision_kv_cache` property collecting {(spec.dtype, spec.kv_quant_mode)} across attention groups and returning len(...) > 1, feeding `return self.has_mamba_layers or self.has_mixed_precision_kv_cache`. READ THE COVERAGE DELTA BELOW - absorbed is not identical here.
PN88.behavioural_delta: P27-CLASS CAVEAT, and worse than P27's: this is a COVERAGE GAP, not a routing difference. PN88 predicated on `has_block_dropping_layers and has_quantized_kv_cache` and counted TQFullAttentionSpec EXPLICITLY, because TQ encodes its quantization in the spec subclass and leaves kv_quant_mode == NONE. Upstream's predicate is 'more than one distinct (dtype, kv_quant_mode) across attention groups', which cannot see a TQ layer as quantized. PROVEN BY EXECUTION on the boot pin, CPU-only throwaway container, a KVCacheConfig with one TQFullAttentionSpec group + one SlidingWindowSpec group, both float16: TQ kv_quant_mode == 0 (NONE); upstream has_mixed_precision_kv_cache -> False; upstream needs_kv_cache_zeroing -> False; PN88's predicate -> True. So on a TQ + sliding-window/chunked-local hybrid, upstream does NOT zero and the stale quantized bytes PN88 existed to kill come back, silently, as NaN/Inf. NOT A LIVE LOSS on this deployment: the tools-text compose is full-attention-only, so has_block_dropping_layers is False and both predicates agree on False - PN88's own docstring says as much. It becomes live the moment a TQ + SWA hybrid is served. RECOMMENDED, and OUT OF THIS AGENT'S LANE (fixes/** belongs to another lane): narrow PN88's self-retire so `has_mixed_precision_kv_cache` alone does not retire it, and have it widen needs_kv_cache_zeroing with the TQ clause instead. The widening is provably free here - has_block_dropping_layers is False, so no extra memset.

PN94.superseded_by: vllm#47953, MERGED upstream as b2b8f679d '[Bugfix][Spec Decode] Restrict embedding-width share guard to EAGLE drafts' (2026-07-21), a strict ancestor of the boot pin's build base 4e2e9bf00. Absorbing code, llm_base_proposer.py:1480 in the PRISTINE boot pin: `if share_embeddings and hasattr(self.model, "has_own_embed_tokens"):` with the comment 'EAGLE drafts consume input embeddings at their own hidden size ... MTP drafts project target-width embeddings ... so the width check does not apply to them'. That is PN94's SUB2 narrowing, expressed as an inline hasattr instead of a named is_eagle_model local. Boot line: 'upstream drift: EAGLE-only width guard already present - self-retire (no-op)'; the self-retire has two alternatives and it is the SECOND (`share_embeddings and hasattr(...)`) that matches - the first (`is_eagle_model`) is count 0, which is why a check of only the first alternative reads as a false alarm. Of the PR pair PN94 backported, only #47953 landed; #47833 is absent from origin/main and was not needed.
PN94.behavioural_delta: None for this deployment and none in principle: upstream narrows the same guard to the same set. PN94 additionally introduced a named `is_eagle_model` local used at both sites; upstream repeats the hasattr at the second site. Same predicate. Our method='mtp' Qwen3_5MTP defines no has_own_embed_tokens, so it takes the MTP branch and always shares, which is what PN94 wanted.

The WRITE is now gated behind a second GENESIS_P82_ACK_UNVALIDATED=1, because GENESIS_ENABLE_P82=1 sat in tcbench8021.yml the whole time the patch was inert and therefore never encoded a decision to ship a biased sampler; the module's own safety model requires genesis_quality_harness >=30/31 first. effective_env_flag points at the ack gate so zero markers reads DARK, not MISSING.
